t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The advice is all over the place. It didn't help at all. In summary, Sometimes, a different colored basket gives you more like red or yellow, sometimes it doesn't. Sometimes, a different gnome will give you more mushrooms, sometimes its the opposite. Not helpful.

vb_textbox.text: Whenever you see a X5, choose the purple one. When that happens, there will always be a red basket that gives you 40 mushrooms. Whenever you see x1, choose the smaller yellow. That will yield more if its a yellow basket. Whenever you see a x1, choose the blue one. Then you will get 7 or 8 mushrooms. The pink and yellow and red ones are usually random. But the purple x 5 one will ALWAYS yield the most.
